description: baseline: LightGBM binary classifier with 5-fold stratified CV (N=891 << 10k threshold), feature engineering (Title from Name, Deck from Cabin, FamilySize/IsAlone, log-Fare, Age missingness indicator), median/mode imputation, and native LightGBM categorical handling
Enhanced feature engineering (TicketPrefix, IsChild, AgeBin, Fare_per_person, Sex_Pclass interaction, IsMother, FamilySizeGroup) + LightGBM+XGBoost ensemble with tuned hyperparameters

Switch to CatBoost with 5-fold OOF evaluation (all 891 samples) + Sex_Pclass interaction feature; CatBoost's ordered boosting excels at small datasets with categorical features, and OOF gives a more stable metric than the single 20% hold-out
Optuna HPO (50 trials) to find optimal CatBoost hyperparameters + add TicketGroup size, FarePerPerson, and WomanOrChild features to CatBoost with 5-fold OOF

3-model ensemble (CatBoost + LightGBM + XGBoost) each with Optuna HPO, plus richer feature engineering (FamilySizeGroup, IsChild, AgeBin, IsMother, SurnameGroup, NumCabins) and Optuna-optimized blend weights over OOF predictions

Added ExtraTrees as 4th diverse base model (bagging vs. boosting), 7 new features (DeckNum ordinal, CabinNum, HasTicketPrefix, NameLength, Fare_class_z within-Pclass, Title_Pclass interaction, Pclass_Embarked interaction), and 2-level stacking with a cross-validated Logistic Regression meta-learner on the 4 OOF prediction arrays

Multi-seed ensemble (5 seeds for CatBoost, 3 for LGB/XGB) to reduce variance from random splits + 3 new interaction features (IsAlone×Pclass, WomanOrChild×Pclass, FamilySize×Pclass) + increased CatBoost HPO to 60 trials; seed-averaging stabilizes OOF predictions on this small N=891 dataset

Title-based Age imputation, K-fold target encoding for categoricals (benefits LGB/XGB), new features (TicketPrefix, Fare_class_z, Age_Pclass), and 3-fold-seed × 5-model-seed final training for smoother OOF estimates
